verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions Signals for reactivity (angular-docs-1) and SSR support (angular-gh-7), but contains no mention of a resource() API, @defer blocks, or any suspense-like loading UI primitive for server-loaded data. Missing for 10: documentation of resource()/async signal primitives, @defer/suspense-style loading UI, and any example combining SSR data fetching with reactive loading states.
